All terms used of this subpart have the same meaning given in the Clean Air Act and subpart A of this part . Subpart YY—Caprolactam, Glyoxal, and Glyoxylic Acid Production Source: 89 FR 31948 , Apr. 25, 2024, unless otherwise noted. § 98.510 Definition of the source category. This source category includes any facility that produces caprolactam, glyoxal, or glyoxylic acid. This source category excludes the production of glyoxal through the LaPorte process ( i.e., the gas-phase catalytic oxidation of ethylene glycol with air in the presence of a silver or copper catalyst). § 98.511 Reporting threshold. You must report GHG emissions under this subpart if your facility meets the requirements of either § 98.2(a)(1) or (2) and the definition of source category in § 98.510 . § 98.512 GHGs to report.
